Showroom.dc.html.title: Direction D — Showroom (real visuals, scroll story)

n1.text: Direction: 'Workshop Ledger' — keeps the Warsha navy/blue brand, adds one amber CTA accent, real copy from /landing. Body font shown is IBM Plex Sans Arabic as a stand-in for Somar. Swap the text badges in the compliance strip for the real ZATCA and Vehicle Safety Center logos.

n2.text: Direction B: 'Open Garage' — light and airy, centered hero with a product window, the ecosystem shown as a hub, clickable feature tabs (press Play), pricing as a comparison table. No amber: the accent is Warsha's own secondary indigo (#2B3891). Kufi headings (Noto Kufi Arabic) over IBM Plex Sans Arabic body.

n3.text: Direction C: 'Pit Lane' — the bold one. Dark telemetry look. The hero is a live AI damage scan: a car wireframe draws itself, a laser scans it, and you click the damage points to update the estimate. Also: a scrolling ticker of documents and integrations, a car driving along the 5 repair steps, the four parties orbiting the workshop, animated control-room cards, clickable plan cards with a spinning glow border, and a giant outline 'ابدأ الآن' with parallax. Press Play and scroll. All motion stops under reduced-motion.

n4.text: Direction D: 'Showroom' — C's energy with your real assets: the real logo, ZATCA and VSC logos, product screenshots, document forms and people photos. Hero screenshot tilted in 3D with floating status chips. 'The Tour': scroll and the screenshot on the left swaps per chapter (sticky, scroll-driven). The documents fan out as you scroll (hover to spread). Four people cards, a top scroll-progress bar, and Saudi-dialect headlines. [ ] = facts still needed: stats, testimonial. Open it full window and scroll.
